candidates.statement: The equation of the modular curve X(7) of level 7 is given by the Klein quartic curve (see [24]) x3y + y3z + z3x = 0 (5.1) in P2. The left hand side of (5.1) is the unique quartic invariant for PSL(2, 7) in this representation.

(5.2) The modular curve X(11) of level 11 is the singular locus of the Hessian of this cubic threefold. In fact, there are only 10 distinct quartics deﬁning the locus, namely v2wz −vwy2 −x2yz = 0, vy3 + w3z + wx3 = 0 and their images under successive applications of the cyclic permutation (vwxyz).
